title: Mona Lisa TSP (100,000 cities)
statement: Find a shortest closed tour through the 100,000 cities of R. Bosch's Mona Lisa instance (mona-lisa100K.tsp, TSPLIB EUC_2D distances). The best known tour has length 5,757,191 (Y. Nagata, 17 Mar 2009) and no tour is shorter than 5,757,084 (Concorde, 27 Jul 2012); W. Cook offers $1,000 for the first tour shorter than 5,757,191.
submission: Text file: a TSPLIB tour file (TOUR_SECTION ending with -1) or the 100,000 city numbers 1..100000 in the order visited, one per line.
score: L, the tour length with EUC_2D distances rounded to the nearest integer (smaller is better)

best_known.source: tour 5,757,191 by Y. Nagata (17 Mar 2009), on W. Cook's Mona Lisa TSP Challenge page; read 9 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: W. Cook, Mona Lisa TSP Challenge

bound.source: Concorde, 27 Jul 2012, on the same page
